results.title: Odisha double murder: Two get life sentences for killing mother and 7 year old boy
results.description: An Odisha court sentenced two relatives to life in prison for brutally murdering a woman and her seven-year-old son to cover up an extramarital affair.

results.title: IIT Gandhinagar and Indian AI Research Organisation collaborate to advance AI research and education
results.description: IIT Gandhinagar and IAIRO sign MoU to advance AI research, education, and innovation, fostering a robust ecosystem for talent development and joint initiatives.
